text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser isn't feeling
especially well,
so I take her to rest in
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making you worry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get plenty of rest until I'm
good and
healthy. Nighty night now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun... Hmmm? This is... umm...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome home. You're taking it easy
today,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
We've prepared a full-course meal with
all your
favorites. Make sure you fill that
belly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you two doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what do you mean by
"full
course"? We have meal sets at our
restaurant.
There is no full course...

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hush now. First, we've got that sea
urchin soupe
de poisson you love, and
sea bream sauté for the
main dish.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! I've never even heard of
those!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? You've always
been
incredibly fond of full-course
French cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've never eaten any of that stuff! I mean poison soup?! Are you for real?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I just want my usual! I want that
ordinarily yummy flavor, so I can be
ordinarily happy. It's just not
home
without it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Please, gods! Give that ordinary flavor
back to
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! This is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
B-b-b-booyah! I'm back to my everyday
life!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is thoroughly
refreshed after
successfully escaping
from her nightmare!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well... Maybe once in a while is okay!
Ehehe, let's
give it a shot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second! This is made of wax! I'm
gonna
break into hives if I eat this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bwuh... It was just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What was all that anyway? I mean, sea
urchin
poison soup?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser's condition fails to
improve
due to her unsettling dream.
